isotronDetailedDescription:
The project, whose name was changed for contractual confidentiality reasons, consisted of developing a complete management and statistics system for a company specializing in the sale of radioactive products for clinics and hospitals.


13 distinct workflows were created, ranging from detailed customer registration control, order issuance and traceability of radioactive materials. These flows were carefully structured to ensure safety, efficiency and compliance in all stages of the operational process.


This project resulted in greater security, agility and operational control for the company, directly contributing to its organization and growth in the sector.
lifemedDetailedDescription:
The project, whose name was changed for contractual confidentiality reasons, aimed to develop a digital platform in the B2B e-commerce model, aimed at connecting suppliers of hospital products to clinics, offices and hospitals.


Several navigation flows were modeled, ranging from the registration and management of products by suppliers, to the search, comparison and request of orders by buyers. The platform's architecture was designed to optimize the experience of both user profiles, ensuring agility, usability and trust in all interactions.
lunaDetailedDescription:
This project was developed with the objective of promoting a better understanding and quality of sleep through continuous monitoring of the user's nightly habits.


In addition to monitoring, complementary features were incorporated, such as suggestions for light stretching before bed and a library of relaxing sounds, such as white noise, nature sounds and soft music, which help in the relaxation process and facilitate sleep induction.
lifesyncDetailedDescription:
The interface of this project was carefully designed to ensure fluid and accessible navigation, with a focus on organization and usability. The user can register their documents, set custom alarms and receive automatic notifications before the expiration date, avoiding forgetfulness and inconvenience.


A highlight of the project was the attention to the security and privacy of personal data. The protection strategies were rigorously elaborated, ensuring that user information is protected against unauthorized access and avoiding any risk of data leakage.
